cite: subdivision (a), Purpose
quote: Under Family Code section 217, at a hearing on any request for order brought under the Family Code, absent a stipulation of the parties or a finding of good cause under (b), the court must receive any live, competent, and admissible testimony that is relevant and within the scope of the hearing.

cite: subdivision (b), Factors -- introductory clause
quote: In addition to the rules of evidence, a court must consider the following factors in making a finding of good cause to refuse to receive live testimony under Family Code section 217:

cite: subdivision (b)(3), credibility
quote: Whether live testimony is necessary for the court to assess the credibility of the parties or other witnesses;

cite: subdivision (c), Findings
quote: If the court makes a finding of good cause to exclude live testimony, it must state its reasons on the record or in writing. The court is required to state only those factors on which the finding of good cause is based.

cite: subdivision (d), Minor children
quote: When receiving or excluding testimony from minor children, in addition to fulfilling the requirements of Evidence Code section 765, the court must follow the procedures in Family Code section 3042 and rule 5.250 of the California Rules of Court governing children's testimony.

cite: subdivision (e), Witness lists
quote: If no witness list has been served, the court may require an offer of proof before allowing any nonparty witness to testify.

cite: subdivision (f), Continuance
quote: The court must consider whether or not a brief continuance is necessary to allow a litigant adequate opportunity to prepare for questioning any witness for the other parties.

cite: subdivision (g), Questioning by court
quote: Whenever the court receives live testimony from a party or any witness it may elicit testimony by directing questions to the parties and other witnesses.

cite: the affirmative factual showing required

cite: Corp. Code § 16308(a), second sentence — public representations

cite: Corp. Code § 16308(c) — being named in a statement of partnership authority

cite: Corp. Code § 16308(e) — closing negative rule
